purpose: Test the intersection of all qualified old and new candidate bounds, not only each rule in isolation. Fixed goal awards are subtracted from the FPL player vector; unresolved goal slots use the intersection of candidate sets. All full2025 scoring teams in the pre-existing control plan are compared. Zero negative residuals, impossible matchings or protected-award exclusions required before publishing the cumulative ledger. Reused/shared-source temporal regression, not independent validation.
